name: Pestana Group
note: Portuguese private hospitality group (Pestana Hotel Group). Per its own site, owned and chaired by Dionísio Pestana, son of founder Manuel Pestana; the group says it bought Madeira's brewery (Empresa de Cervejas da Madeira, brewer of Coral) in the 1990s (claims pestana-group-pestana-ownership and ecm-pestana-group-ownership). No state or state-fund shareholder identified.
